description_en: Creates a logon profile for a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
name: CreateLoginProfile

parameters.help_en: The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.help_en: The console logon password of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user. The password must meet the password strength requirements
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的控制台登录密码。

密码必须符合密码强度要求
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user is required to reset the password upon the next logon. Valid values:

true
false (default)
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户在下次登录时是否必须重置密码。取值：

true
false（默认值）
parameters.name: password_reset_required

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user is required to enable multi-factor authentication (MFA). Valid values:

true: Required. The Resource Access Management (RAM) user must attach an MFA device upon the next logon.
false (default): Not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制要求RAM用户开启多因素认证。取值：

true：要求开启。RAM用户在下次登录时必须绑定多因素认证设备。
false（默认值）：不要求开启
parameters.name: mfa_bind_required

parameters.help_en:
The status of console password logon. Valid values:

Active (default): Enabled.
Inactive: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
开启或禁用控制台密码登录。取值：

Active（默认值）：开启。
Inactive：禁用
parameters.name: status

MFABindRequired.description_en: Indicates whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user is required to enable multi-factor authentication (MFA)
MFABindRequired.description_zh: 是否强制要求RAM用户开启多因素认证

PasswordResetRequired.description_en: Indicates whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user is required to reset the password upon the next logon
PasswordResetRequired.description_zh: RAM用户在下次登录时是否必须重置密码

PasswordStatus.description_en:
The status of the initial password. An initial password is the password set when console logon is created or re-enabled. Valid values:
"NotInitial": The password is not an initial password.
"InitialValid": The initial password is valid.
"InitialExpired": The initial password has expired
PasswordStatus.description_zh:
初始密码的状态。初始密码指新创建或重新启用控制台登录设置的密码。

取值
"NotInitial"：非初始密码。
"InitialValid"：初始密码有效。
"InitialExpired"：初始密码已过期

Status.description_en: The status of console password logon
Status.description_zh: 开启或禁用控制台密码登录

UpdateDate.description_en: The update time. The time is in the RFC 3339 format in UTC, such as 2020-10-14T03:47:51Z

UserPrincipalName.description_en: The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user
